Definition: to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to slaughter, kill, sacrifice, slaughter for sacrifice; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to slaughter for sacrifice; 1a2) to slaughter for eating; 1a3) to slaughter in divine judgment; 1b) (Piel) to sacrifice, offer sacrifice
